# posthog_schema_property_group (Resource)

Manage PostHog schema property groups: named groups of typed properties that can be attached to events via `posthog_event_schema`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "posthog_schema_property_group" "checkout" {
  name        = "Checkout"
  description = "Properties shared by checkout events"

  properties = [
    {
      name          = "cart_value"
      property_type = "Numeric"
      is_required   = true
    },
    {
      name          = "currency"
      property_type = "String"
    },
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the property group. Unique per project.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the property group.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (environment) for this resource. Overrides the provider-level project_id.
- `properties` (Attributes Set) Typed properties in this group. Property names are unique within a group. Updates replace the full property list server-side. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--properties))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the property group was created.
- `id` (String) UUID of the property group.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the property group was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--properties"></a>
### Nested Schema for `properties`

Required:

- `name` (String) Property name.
- `property_type` (String) Property type: `DateTime`, `String`, `Numeric`, `Boolean`, or `Object`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) Property description.
- `is_optional_in_types` (Boolean) Whether the property is marked optional in generated type definitions.
- `is_required` (Boolean) Whether events must include this property to conform to the schema.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using: project_id/property_group_uuid
terraform import posthog_schema_property_group.checkout 12345/your-property-group-uuid

# If project_id is configured at the provider level, you can omit it:
terraform import posthog_schema_property_group.checkout your-property-group-uuid
```
